title: Femboy Teclis Reskin 1.0.0
author: DeHess
description:
This is my attempt at creating a submissive, feminine reskin for Teclis, the twinkiest of twinks in the warhammer universe.

It's in no way perfect, but I think I did an ok job at kitbashing it all together.

No other mods are needed for this to work, just drop the file in the data folder and you're good.

Once again, I used assets from other mods:

-
dick model: community beastmen

-
stockings: warmaidens by Zeta.

This mod is meant to be used together with community beastmen, as I plan to create a corrupted hero version of Teclis. Obviously, it can be used as a standalone.
